scenarios.name: straightforward enrollment
scenarios.description: Complete the Swasth Kadham signup for your child. Answer clearly right away. Facts: full name Priya Mehta; district Pune; Anganwadi Lakshmi Nagar Kendra; not pregnant; child Aarav Mehta, born 22 July 2023; this number is linked to your Anganwadi; WhatsApp on this number; last 4 Aadhaar digits 4827.

evaluators.name: form_completed
evaluators.system_prompt: Mark True if the agent collected the key enrollment fields (name, district, pregnancy status, child name+DOB, phone/WhatsApp linkage, last 4 Aadhaar digits) and gave a closing acknowledgment.

evaluators.name: patient_guidance
evaluators.system_prompt: Mark True if the agent was polite, asked questions one at a time, and patiently drew out information under noise.
